base64.description: Encode or decode data as base64.

fields.label: Decode (-d)
fields.tooltip: Decode data. Default is to encode.

fields.label: File
fields.tooltip:
File to encode/decode. Leave blank for text input.

HTB Tip:
Used to obscure data or shells. e.g., echo 'bash -i...' | base64

xxd.description: Creates a hex dump of a file or standard input.

fields.label: Reverse (hex -> binary)
fields.tooltip:
Reverses a hex dump back into its original binary form.
Conflicts with 'Columns'.

fields.label: Columns (bytes per line)
fields.tooltip:
e.g., 16 (Default). Ignored if 'Reverse' is checked.
Conflicts with 'Reverse'.

fields.label: File
fields.tooltip:
File to process. Leave blank for text input.

Pen Testing Tip:
Useful for analyzing binary file formats or creating shellcode.
